units.english: As you are approaching the <origin>, your radar sensors detect that the ship you are assisting is about to be slammed by a huge asteroid! While in a normal flight this wouldn't cause much trouble, a ship that has already suffered heavy damage and cannot dodge could be completely destroyed.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini alla <origin>, i tuoi sensori radar rilevano che la nave che stai assistendo sta per essere colpita in pieno da un gigantesco asteroide! In un volo normale non sarebbe un gran problema, ma una nave già gravemente danneggiata e incapace di schivare potrebbe essere distrutta del tutto.

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	You turn your ship around and activate your thrusters, trying to get as far as you can from the disabled ship. A few seconds later, the asteroid collides with the <origin>, tearing it to shreds and killing all of its crew members while leaving little more than a scratch on the asteroid's surface.|207|0
units.english: You turn your ship around and activate your thrusters, trying to get as far as you can from the disabled ship. A few seconds later, the asteroid collides with the <origin>, tearing it to shreds and killing all of its crew members while leaving little more than a scratch on the asteroid's surface.
units.italian: Giri la nave e attivi i propulsori, cercando di allontanarti il più possibile dalla nave in avaria. Pochi secondi dopo, l'asteroide si scontra con la <origin>, facendola a pezzi e uccidendo tutti i membri dell'equipaggio, mentre sulla superficie dell'asteroide lascia poco più che un graffio.

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	You fire at the asteroid in an attempt to destroy it, but it looks like you've only made things worse. The asteroid has now broken up into dozens of smaller chunks still flying directly for the <origin>. Before you can even react to fix your mistake, most of the chunks have already hit the <origin>, which is now quickly depressurizing. There's nothing more you can do except move a safe distance away from the exploding ship...|212|0
units.english: You fire at the asteroid in an attempt to destroy it, but it looks like you've only made things worse. The asteroid has now broken up into dozens of smaller chunks still flying directly for the <origin>. Before you can even react to fix your mistake, most of the chunks have already hit the <origin>, which is now quickly depressurizing. There's nothing more you can do except move a safe distance away from the exploding ship...
units.italian: Sparisci all'asteroide nel tentativo di distruggerlo, ma sembra che tu abbia solo peggiorato le cose. L'asteroide si è ormai spezzato in decine di frammenti più piccoli che volano ancora dritti verso la <origin>. Prima che tu possa reagire per rimediare all'errore, la maggior parte dei frammenti ha già colpito la <origin>, che ora si sta rapidamente depressurizzando. Non c'è altro da fare che allontanarsi a una distanza di sicurezza dalla nave che esplode...

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	The shots you fire quickly break the asteroid into pieces, which seem to have changed course enough to completely miss the <origin>. After repairing it, you hail its captain, who thanks you with a payment of 30,000 credits.|215|0
units.english: The shots you fire quickly break the asteroid into pieces, which seem to have changed course enough to completely miss the <origin>. After repairing it, you hail its captain, who thanks you with a payment of 30,000 credits.
units.italian: I colpi che spari spezzano rapidamente l'asteroide, i cui frammenti sembrano aver cambiato rotta abbastanza da mancare del tutto la <origin>. Dopo averla riparata, chiami il suo capitano, che ti ringrazia con un pagamento di 30.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	You dock with the <origin>, hoping to get out of this alive, but as soon as you reach the hatch, the asteroid hits and a series of explosions start coming from the disabled ship. You are able to reach your cockpit and undock, but the crew on the other ship couldn't reach yours in time...|220|0
units.english: You dock with the <origin>, hoping to get out of this alive, but as soon as you reach the hatch, the asteroid hits and a series of explosions start coming from the disabled ship. You are able to reach your cockpit and undock, but the crew on the other ship couldn't reach yours in time...
units.italian: Attracchi alla <origin>, sperando di uscirne vivo, ma appena raggiungi il portello l'asteroide colpisce e una serie di esplosioni comincia a venire dalla nave in avaria. Riesci a raggiungere la cabina di pilotaggio e a sganciarti, ma l'equipaggio dell'altra nave non ha fatto in tempo a raggiungerti...

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	You dock with the <origin>, hoping to get out of this alive, but, as soon as you reach the hatch, the asteroid hits and a series of explosions start coming from the disabled ship. Most of the other ship's crew has been able to reach your ship by the time you undock from it, and they ask you to take them to <destination>.|223|0
units.english: You dock with the <origin>, hoping to get out of this alive, but, as soon as you reach the hatch, the asteroid hits and a series of explosions start coming from the disabled ship. Most of the other ship's crew has been able to reach your ship by the time you undock from it, and they ask you to take them to <destination>.
units.italian: Attracchi alla <origin>, sperando di uscirne vivo, ma, appena raggiungi il portello, l'asteroide colpisce e una serie di esplosioni comincia a venire dalla nave in avaria. Quando ti sganci, la maggior parte dell'equipaggio dell'altra nave è riuscita a raggiungere la tua, e ti chiede di portarli su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	"How much can you pay me?"|227|0

mission:Asteroid Course|	"I have a few hundred thousand credits," one of them says, presumably the captain. "I need to save enough to buy a new starship, but you will still receive a decent pay."|228|0
units.english: "I have a few hundred thousand credits," one of them says, presumably the captain. "I need to save enough to buy a new starship, but you will still receive a decent pay."
units.italian: "Ho qualche centinaio di migliaia di crediti", dice uno di loro, presumibilmente il capitano. "Devo metterne da parte abbastanza per comprare una nuova astronave, ma riceverai comunque una paga decente."

units.id: mission:Asteroid Course|	The asteroid, after hitting your shield, breaks into a million fragments which fly away from the <origin>. After repairing it, you hail its captain, who thanks you with a payment of 30,000 credits.|231|0
units.english: The asteroid, after hitting your shield, breaks into a million fragments which fly away from the <origin>. After repairing it, you hail its captain, who thanks you with a payment of 30,000 credits.
units.italian: L'asteroide, dopo aver colpito il tuo scudo, si spezza in un milione di frammenti che si allontanano dalla <origin>. Dopo averla riparata, chiami il suo capitano, che ti ringrazia con un pagamento di 30.000 crediti.

units.english: The captain you talked with before thanks you again for saving him and his crew, and hands you <payment>.
units.italian: Il capitano con cui avevi parlato ti ringrazia di nuovo per aver salvato lui e il suo equipaggio, e ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Journey|When you repair the <origin>, the captain hails you. "This is the fourth time I've nearly died in the past week doing this job! Here, take this <cargo> to <destination> and finish this job for me. They said the payment is <payment>."|260|0
units.english: When you repair the <origin>, the captain hails you. "This is the fourth time I've nearly died in the past week doing this job! Here, take this <cargo> to <destination> and finish this job for me. They said the payment is <payment>."
units.italian: Quando ripari la <origin>, il capitano ti chiama. "È la quarta volta che quasi ci lascio le penne questa settimana facendo questo lavoro! Tieni, porta questo <cargo> a <destination> e finisci il lavoro al posto mio. Hanno detto che il pagamento è <payment>."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Journey|	The captain begins loudly swearing, so you cut the feed. Hopefully they make it to their destination in one piece.|265|0
units.english: The captain begins loudly swearing, so you cut the feed. Hopefully they make it to their destination in one piece.
units.italian: Il capitano comincia a imprecare ad alta voce, così interrompi la comunicazione. Speriamo che arrivi a destinazione tutto intero.

units.english: You drop off your cargo of <commodity>, explain how the original merchant who took the job quit and handed off the cargo to you, and collect your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Scarichi il tuo carico di <commodity>, spieghi che il mercante che aveva accettato il lavoro ha rinunciato e ti ha passato il carico, e incassi il pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: conversation:assisting law enforcement|The captain of the <origin> thanks you for repairing them, but informs you that the pirates that disabled them are only a smaller part of a fleet attacking <destination>.|274|0
units.english: The captain of the <origin> thanks you for repairing them, but informs you that the pirates that disabled them are only a smaller part of a fleet attacking <destination>.
units.italian: Il capitano della <origin> ti ringrazia per la riparazione, ma ti informa che i pirati che li hanno messi fuori uso sono solo una piccola parte di una flotta che attacca <destination>.

units.id: conversation:assisting law enforcement|	The authorities of <planet> will probably pay you quite well if you assist them, but this could also be an easy way to get yourself killed.|275|0
units.english: The authorities of <planet> will probably pay you quite well if you assist them, but this could also be an easy way to get yourself killed.
units.italian: Le autorità di <planet> probabilmente ti pagheranno bene se le assisti, ma potrebbe anche essere un modo facile di farti ammazzare.
